releaseTag.description: release-unit: the ONE tag every gonk image (controller, intake, meter, agent) deploys under unless its own image.tag overrides it. Empty only when every enabled component sets its own tag; the render fails (G24) if any resolves to no tag. `latest` is rejected (G11).

imageFloor.description: Image floors (gonk-xsk3). Chart.yaml's gonk-factory.github.io/image-floor.* annotations name the oldest build of each image this chart can run against; the render refuses older ones. acceptUnrankedTags: tags with no build number cannot be compared, and are refused unless this attests the images were built from the same commit as the chart.

webhookPublicURL.description: REQUIRED. Intake writes this into every GitLab hook it provisions.

dispatchStalenessWindow.description: GONK_DISPATCH_STALENESS_WINDOW. Optional; empty resolves to intake's own default (30m).

enabled.description: Deploy the bundled Gas City controller. false => BYO controller; supervisorURL becomes required (G17).

supervisorPort.description: SETTLED (Task 0.5, smoke U1): the per-city [api] listener (0.0.0.0:9443). NOT 8372, the loopback-only supervisor admin API that must never be exposed.

delivery.description: SETTLED (Task 0.5, smoke U2): prebaked ONLY. The pack is baked into the image and an initContainer copies it into a writable /city. A read-only ConfigMap at /city is not viable (gc init must write there). Single-value enum, future-proof.

workload.description: SETTLED (Task 0.5, smoke U3): Deployment (strategy Recreate) is the default; StatefulSet is the single-instance alternative. Both are exactly one replica; the upstream bare-Pod hack is dropped.

verifyKey.description: G22. The ed25519 PUBLIC verify key (GC_CITY_WRITE_PUBKEY) the grant-gated controller checks X-GC-City-Write grants against. Format 'kid:base64' (STANDARD base64 of the raw 32-byte ed25519 public key; comma-separate for rotation). A PUBLIC key, not a secret. REQUIRED (non-empty) when gascity.enabled, else the 0.0.0.0/allow_mutations [api] plane is unauthenticated.

cid.description: Optional tenancy cid (GC_CITY_WRITE_CID). Empty => untenanted (aud=gc-city-write.v2, cid=''). Set only if the controller runs with the same cid.

sweepHealthMaxAge.description: How stale the gonk-sweep health record may be before the controller's readinessProbe calls the outcome path dead (gonk-pop3 / gonk-p7qh). A Go duration string.

dolt.description: The bundled Dolt SQL server. RECONCILED, Task 0: backs the Gas City beads store ONLY -- the meter ledger is always Postgres/CNPG (ADR-004 Decision 10; there is no ledger.backend=dolt). Beads is Dolt-only; there is no Postgres path for beads.

enabled.description: Deploy the bundled Dolt StatefulSet. false => external Dolt; dolt.external.host becomes required (G16).

username.description: R-48/T-26: the ONLY user the controller connects to Dolt as, GRANT-scoped to ONLY the beads database. Its password lives in secrets.dolt.keys.gcPassword, never here.

ledger.description: The METER ledger backend. RECONCILED, Task 0: Postgres/CNPG is the ONLY backend (ADR-004 Decision 10; docs/spikes/dolt-reservation-isolation.md -- Dolt measured, and failed, the reservation-race isolation test). It is LEDGER-ONLY -- it never replaces the beads store, which stays on the top-level `dolt` component regardless of this value.

backend.description: A single-value enum, not a switch: `dolt` is deliberately absent (there is no store.OpenDolt for the ledger -- see the spike). `memory` is also absent: it loses reservations on restart, which is fail-open on budget headroom.

workstore.description: gonk-t41: the Postgres DSN (key dsn) of gonk-gate's work store, as role gonk_workstore -- NOT the meter's ledger role. File-mounted into the controller when workstore.enabled.

dolt.description: R-48/T-26: the bundled Dolt's root password (keys.rootPassword, bundled Dolt only) and the `gc` user's password (keys.gcPassword, required whenever any Dolt -- bundled or external -- is reachable). Consumed as an env var, not a file, at the point the dolthub image and Gas City's `gc` binary each read it -- see chart/gonk/README.md.

existingSecret.description: G22. NAME of a pre-provisioned Secret holding the ed25519 PRIVATE signing key intake+gate mint grants with. The chart creates NO Secret and reads NO value -- a 0400 file mount only. REQUIRED (non-empty) when gascity.enabled.

key.description: The key within that Secret holding the PEM PKCS#8 key or raw 32-byte seed.

ladder.description: G1. An empty instance ladder imposes NO constraint, so a project could name any rung. gonk-meter also refuses to start without one.

kubeAPI.description: gonk-vxel: the Kubernetes API server's addresses, rendered as an ipBlock egress rule on the controller and meter policies. Empty cidrs renders no rule; on a cluster that enforces NetworkPolicy that leaves both pods unable to call the API. See values.yaml.

cidrs.description: The addresses behind the `kubernetes` Service (its EndpointSlice), each as a CIDR. Not the Service's cluster IP.

ports.description: The TCP port(s) of those endpoints (6443 on most self-managed clusters, 443 on most managed ones).

enforcementProbe.description: helm test probe that measures whether this cluster enforces the gonk-agent egress policy. `enabled: false` is for clusters where the probe cannot run, NOT for silencing a red result.

workstore.description: gonk-t41: gonk-gate's work-item store in Postgres (its own role and schema). See values.yaml.

enabled.description: Mount secrets.workstore into the controller and run the bd import in bootstrap-city.

importBreakGlass.description: Let the controller start on the last complete import when the bd import cannot complete. Refused on a never-imported store.

freshInstall.description: Assert a fresh install, so bd's missing database is an empty import. Implied while Helm installs the release; set only to recover a fresh install whose first pod never reached gc start. Refused by the import on a store holding records.

podReap.description: gonk-mfsr: let gonk-gate's sweep DELETE a leaked agent pod (one whose session bead gascity already closed, which no gascity call can reach). See values.yaml.

enabled.description: Set GONK_POD_REAP_NAMESPACE on the controller and render Role/RoleBinding gonk-gate-podreap. FALSE by default: merging the chart must not be able to arm pod deletion.

sessionRuntime.description: gonk-t55: how gonk-gate runs each agent session as a Kubernetes Job (plan D6). The image is componentImages.agent; the namespace and ServiceAccount are fixed. Rendered to the controller as GONK_SESSION_* env.

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: The Job's ttlSecondsAfterFinished. The sweep reads a finished session's log and runs about every 60s; below a few sweep intervals a finished session is judged absent.

dev.description: Dev-only diagnostics. Everything here is off by default; the always-on observability records (intake decision, transcript read, session spend, sweep health) are not configured from here and cannot be switched off.

transcripts.description: Archive each finished session's full transcript on the controller so it survives the agent pod the reaper destroys. Holds untrusted model output over untrusted user input: off in production.

tag.description: One of gonk's own images. Empty -> releaseTag (release-unit). A render where an enabled component resolves to no tag fails (G24). `latest` is rejected (G11).

existingSecret.description: The NAME of a Secret provisioned outside this chart. G7/G14: there is no way to inline a value, and no way to disable verification.

then.description: G4. An unpriced cloud rung sails past the cost gate. A synthetic price on a cloud rung is a lie: its price is real and lives in LiteLLM.
G3. Without a synthetic price, LiteLLM's USD ceiling never closes on tokens.
